messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-15T09:12:25Z - cache miss surge detected on route /v1/embed/*; prefix miss-rate +340% vs baseline, origin 5xx +18%, downstream p95 latency 2.1s. Pager delivered to oncall.#

alice (oncall): Oncall acked. Investigating cache layer first. Visible symptoms: very high origin qps for embed reads. Suspect cache re-probing after invalidation. Starting live timeline.

ben (sre): grabbing logs from kv-nodes, pulling recent invalidation jobs. Share metrics link: https://graf.redwood/internal/d/kv/prefix-metrics?from=now-30m to=now

carla (prod-eng): I saw a large purge job ran ~09:08 by the deployment pipeline (deploy-ops). Could be a mistaken glob. @frank can you confirm which keyspace was targeted?

frank (infra): checking audit logs... one invalidate call: 
```
POST /internal/cache/invalidate
user: deploy-bot
payload: {"prefix":"/v1/embed/","mode":"recursive","initiator":"pipeline-2026-03-15-0906"}
```
It returned 200. That matches spike start.

alice (oncall): hypothesis 1: pipeline purge removed warm prefixes causing mass reprobe (cache stampede). Hypothesis 2: TTL misconfiguration on warmed keys causing rapid expiry + reuse mismatch. Prioritizing mitigations: 1) stop more purge jobs, 2) enable short-term emergency rewarm for top prefixes, 3) add temporary fallback to larger model routing to reduce origin load.

dave (oncall-2): I've disabled the pipeline job trigger and put a hold on deploys in the CI. Noted.

elaine (support): customer-impact check: Support ticket queue shows 6 customer reports of timeouts for embedders (3rd-party integrations). Flagging enterprise customers A, C impacted. Not a full outage but SLO degradation.

ben (sre): sharing kv shard hit-rate snapshot (last 20m): 
```
kv-prefix:/v1/embed/ hit_rate: 7% -> 1.8% (09:00 -> 09:13)
origin_qps: 1200 -> 5300
5xx_rate_origin: 0.6% -> 18%
```
We see hit-rate collapse coincident with purge.

carla (prod-eng): rolling a targeted rewarm script to repopulate hot prefixes. Using sampling of recent requests to rebuild cache in a controlled ramp. Script below: 
```
curl -sS https://internal-ops/warm?prefix=/v1/embed/&samples=2000 | xargs -P8 -I{} curl -X POST https://cache-internal/put -d '{}'
```
Starting rewarm job now, rate-limited at 500 qps.

alice (oncall): mitigation in-flight: rewarm started, deploy pipeline paused, TTLs checking. Can someone add a temporary circuit-breaker at the router to cap origin qps per-tenant to 300? That will reduce blast radius.

frank (infra): circuit-breaker implemented at edge via config flag 'origin_qps_cap=300' for embed route. Applied 09:18 UTC.

ben (sre): rewarm progress: 09:22 UTC hit_rate moved to 9%, origin_qps down to 2100. Still elevated but trending.

elaine (support): notif draft for affected customers prepared: short incident note + ETA for mitigation. Approving to send to top impacted accounts.

carla (prod-eng): additional evidence: cache invalidation job included an unintended trailing slash mismatch on prefix pattern, so keys with and without slash were not de-duplicated causing double invalidation across 3 keyspaces. Patch to job template submitted. PR: https://git.redwood/pipelines/1234

ben (sre): collecting timeline for RCA: 
- 09:06: pipeline triggered recursive invalidate /v1/embed/
- 09:08: purge returned 200
- 09:09: origin qps starts climbing
- 09:12: pager fires (miss surge)
- 09:15: rewarm job staged
- 09:18: router circuit-breaker applied
- 09:22: hit-rate begins to recover

alice (oncall): live notes: customer impact limited (timeouts and slow responses), no data loss. Post-incident actions: 1) rollback purge-by-default in pipeline, 2) add safety checks to invalidation tool (confirm target keyspace, confirm sample size), 3) rework warmers to be idempotent and rate-limited, 4) add metric alert for mass invalidations.

dave (oncall-2): I'll own the postmortem timeline and collection of logs. Ben and Carla, please attach the rewarm script, purge audit logs, and metrics snapshots to the incident doc.

ben (sre): attaching sample logs (redacted): 
```
[09:07:58] invalidate: user=deploy-bot prefix=/v1/embed/ mode=recursive
[09:08:02] kv-node-12: evict_count=120k
[09:09:10] origin-1: 502 upstream timeout x 70
[09:11:34] router: 429 flood - rate-limiting engaged
```

carla (prod-eng): quick follow-up: recommend we add a staggered invalidation mode to pipeline (invalidates in batches with cool-down) and an automatic rewarm queue spawn. Filing follow-up tickets.

elaine (support): sent customer notifications at 09:28 UTC.

alice (oncall): closing live mitigation: system stable enough to remove emergency breakers at 09:38 after hit_rate > 85% of baseline and origin qps normalized. We'll keep monitoring. Turning thread into RCA coordination doc.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, customers notified, postmortem assigned to dave. Severity: Sev2 (partial degradation).
